noDatabase.title: No database connected
noDatabase.body: Set DATABASE_URL and run pnpm db:migrate to see gifts, donors, volunteers and messages here.

dashboard.lead: Totals are all-time and net of refunds. Changes compare the last 30 days with the 30 days before.
dashboard.empty: No gifts yet. They'll appear here once Stripe sends its first payment.

donations.lead: Every successful charge, newest first. Monthly gifts appear once per payment.

donors.lead: Everyone who's given, ordered by their latest gift.

volunteers.lead: Sign-ups from the Get involved page, newest first.

messages.lead: Messages from the contact form, newest first. Reply from your inbox; each one was also emailed to the group.

campaigns.lead: Time-limited appeals with a goal, like a giving day. Share a campaign link and every gift made through it counts towards the goal.
campaigns.emptyBody: Create one with a goal and optional dates, then share its donate link. Gifts made through the link count towards the goal.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.body: No gifts have come in through this campaign yet. Its link will stop showing progress, though gifts made through it will still go through.

form.description: The link name goes in the campaign link, so keep it short. Dates are in UTC and only label the campaign; gifts made through the link count whenever they come in.
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, like giving-day-2026.
form.slugLocked: Gifts have come in through this link, so it can no longer change.

errors.slug: Use 1–64 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes.
errors.endsBeforeStart: The end date can’t be before the start date.

funds.lead: The funds donors can choose from, in the order they see them. Changes reach the site straight away.
funds.lastOn: At least one fund has to stay on.

notices.turnedOn: {name} is showing on the site again.
notices.turnedOff: {name} is hidden from the site. Monthly gifts already set up keep going to it.

unavailable: No database connected, so there is nothing to export.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your role doesn’t include this page. Ask an owner if you need it.

team.lead: Who can open the back office and what each person’s role lets them do. Only owners see this page.
team.pendingSignIn: They’ll get an email with a link to confirm their address, choose a password and set up two-step verification.
team.name: Name
team.emailHint: The address they’ll sign in with.
team.empty: No one has been added yet.
team.rolesLead: Roles are set in the code, so changing what a role can do goes through review like any other change.

errors.name: Enter their name.
errors.invalid: That change wasn’t valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.emailTaken: Someone with that email is already on the team. Change their role in the list instead.
errors.notFound: That person is no longer on the team. Reload the page.
errors.lastOwner: There has to be at least one owner with access. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.noDatabase: Connect a database to manage the team.
errors.alreadySetUp: They’ve already set up their account.

team.inviteSent: Added {name} as {role}. We emailed them a link to set up their account.
team.inviteNotSent: Added {name} as {role}, but the email couldn’t be sent. Send them this link yourself. It works once and expires in 7 days:
team.resentNotSent: The email couldn’t be sent. Send {name} this link yourself:

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}’s access?
removeDialog.body: {name} will be signed out straight away and won’t be able to sign in. You can restore their access later.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Everything, including adding people and changing roles.

treasurer.name: Treasurer
treasurer.description: Gifts and donors with their exports, plus campaigns and funds.

coordinator.name: Coordinator
coordinator.description: Volunteers and messages with their exports.

viewer.name: Viewer
viewer.description: Dashboard totals only. No names or contact details.

permissions.donors:view: See donors and their contact details

auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in isn’t set up yet. The site needs a database and AUTH_SECRET.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: For members of the team. You’ll need your authenticator app too.
signIn.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter the email you sign in with and we’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {email} belongs to someone on the team, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in an hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: You’ll be signed out everywhere and can sign in again with the new password.

verify.title: Welcome, {name}
verify.lead: Your email is confirmed once you choose a password. Next you’ll set up an authenticator app.

linkInvalid.title: This link doesn’t work
linkInvalid.body: It may have expired or already been used. Ask an owner to send a new invite, or reset your password if you’ve set one before.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryLead: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each one works once.
twoFactor.lostAccess: Lost your phone and your recovery codes? Ask an owner to reset your two-step verification.

setup.title: Set up two-step verification
setup.lead: Everyone on the team uses an authenticator app, because the back office holds donors’ details.
setup.step1: Scan this code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Authy.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.manual: Can’t scan it? Enter this key instead:
setup.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.codesLead: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager. You won’t see them again.

errors.recoveryCode: Enter a recovery code, like abcde-fghjk.
errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.invalid: That email and password don’t match.
errors.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Wait 15 minutes, or reset your password.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.expired: That took too long or had too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
errors.wrongCode: That code didn’t work. Check the app and try again.
errors.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used.
errors.timeZone: Choose a time zone from the list.

invite.subject: Set up your {orgName} back office account
invite.heading: Hi {name}
invite.added: {invitedBy} added you to the {orgName} back office as {role}.
invite.instructions: Confirm your email and choose a password with the button below. The link works once and expires in 7 days.
invite.footer: If you weren’t expecting this, you can ignore it.

reset.subject: Reset your back office password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.instructions: Someone asked to reset the password for {email}. If it was you, choose a new one with the button below. The link works once and expires in an hour.
reset.footer: If you didn’t ask for this, ignore it. Your password hasn’t changed.

security.notYou: If this wasn’t you, change your password now and tell an owner.
security.footer: You get these emails because security alerts are on in your back office settings.

signedIn.subject: New sign-in to the {orgName} back office
signedIn.heading: You signed in
signedIn.body: Your back office account was just signed in to with your password and authenticator app.

recoveryCodeUsed.subject: A recovery code was used on your {orgName} account
recoveryCodeUsed.heading: A recovery code was used
recoveryCodeUsed.body: Someone signed in to your back office account with one of your recovery codes. Each code works once, so make new ones if you’re running low.

passwordChanged.subject: Your {orgName} back office password changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your back office account was changed from Settings. Your other devices were signed out.

passwordReset.subject: Your {orgName} back office password was reset
passwordReset.heading: Your password was reset
passwordReset.body: The password for your back office account was reset with an emailed link. Every device was signed out.

twoFactorEnabled.subject: Two-step verification is on for your {orgName} account
twoFactorEnabled.heading: Two-step verification is on
twoFactorEnabled.body: An authenticator app was set up for your back office account. You’ll need a code from it each time you sign in.

recoveryCodesRegenerated.subject: New recovery codes for your {orgName} account
recoveryCodesRegenerated.heading: You made new recovery codes
recoveryCodesRegenerated.body: New recovery codes were made for your back office account. The old ones no longer work.

settings.lead: Your account, security and preferences, plus settings for the whole site.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: Ask an owner if your email needs to change.

password.title: Password
password.lead: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {You have no recovery codes left. Make new ones now.} one {# recovery code left.} other {# recovery codes left.}}

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.others: {count, plural, =0 {You aren’t signed in anywhere else.} one {You’re also signed in on # other device.} other {You’re also signed in on # other devices.}}

errors.invalid: Some settings weren’t valid. Check them and try again.
errors.unavailable: Settings can’t be saved without a database.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.emailOff: Email isn’t set up on this site yet (RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM), so nothing will be sent until it is.

notifyVolunteers.label: New volunteer sign-ups
notifyVolunteers.hint: A copy of each volunteer form as it comes in. The team inbox gets these too.

notifyMessages.label: New contact messages
notifyMessages.hint: A copy of each contact form message. Reply to the email to answer the sender.

notifySecurity.label: Security alerts
notifySecurity.hint: When you sign in, change your password, or use or replace recovery codes. We recommend keeping this on.

preferences.title: Display
preferences.lead: How the back office looks for you. Other people’s settings aren’t affected.
preferences.timeZoneHint: Dates and times in tables and the audit log use this zone.
preferences.pageSizeHint: How many rows tables show before you page through them.

platform.title: Platform
platform.lead: Settings for the whole site and everyone on the team. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
platform.inboxHintFallback: Volunteer sign-ups and contact messages are emailed here. Leave it empty to use {email} from ORG_NOTIFY_EMAIL.
platform.inboxHintNone: Volunteer sign-ups and contact messages are emailed here. If it’s empty they’re only saved in the back office and sent to anyone who turned those notifications on.
platform.donationsPausedHint: Visitors can’t start a new gift; the donate form says giving is unavailable. Monthly gifts already set up keep going.
platform.sessionHoursHint: Applies from each person’s next sign-in.
platform.someone: someone no longer on the team

audit.lead: Who did what in the back office: sign-ins, team, campaign, fund and settings changes, and data downloads. Newest first.

auth.sign_in_locked: Tried to sign in while locked
auth.invite_accepted: Accepted invite and set a password
auth.password_reset: Reset password from an emailed link

team.updated_from_cli: Added or updated from the command line

fund.turned_on: Showed a fund on the site
fund.turned_off: Hid a fund from the site

errors.invalid: Something in that change wasn’t valid. Check it and try again.
errors.slugTaken: Another campaign already uses that link name.
errors.notFound: That campaign no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.hasGifts: Gifts have come in through this campaign, so its link can’t change and it can’t be deleted.
errors.lastFund: At least one fund has to stay on.
errors.unknown: That didn’t save. Check your connection and try again.
